title: orbdev pipeline test
narration: This is an orbdev pipeline test. A story file becomes narration, captions, motion graphics, and a finished vertical video in the cloud. The renderer keeps the visual style simple, readable, and fast. Once this test passes, new stories can use the same pipeline automatically.

scenes.title: One story file. One finished Short.
Narration, captions and motion graphics
scenes.body: The render is assembled automatically from structured story data.

scenes.title: No laptop rendering required
scenes.body: The job runs on a hosted GitHub runner and stores the result as an artifact.
